<!-- Right News Card -->
::: {.news-card}
<div style="margin-bottom: 1rem;" class="news-header">
  <h3 style="margin: 0;">News & Events</h3>
  <a href="news_archive.qmd">View Archive</a>
</div>

```{python}

import pandas as pd
import yaml
from IPython.display import display, HTML
from datetime import date

# Load news announcements from YAML
with open("content/news.yml", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    news_data = yaml.safe_load(file)

df = pd.DataFrame(news_data["news"])

# Parse publication dates
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"], errors="coerce")
df = df[df["date"].notna()]

# Blank expiration = keep
# Expiration date in past = hide from news card
today = pd.Timestamp(date.today())

if "expiration" in df.columns:
    df["expiration"] = pd.to_datetime(df["expiration"], errors="coerce")
    df = df[
        df["expiration"].isna()
        | (df["expiration"] >= today)
    ]

# Sort newest first
df = df.sort_values(by="date", ascending=False)

# Show latest 3 entries
latest_news = df.head(3)

html = ""
for _, row in latest_news.iterrows():
    day = row["date"].day
    month_year = row["date"].strftime("%b. %Y")

    html += f"""
    <div class='news-item'>
      <p class='news-title'>{row['title']}</p>
      <p>{row['description']}</p>
      <p class='news-date'>{day} {month_year}</p>
    </div>
    """

display(HTML(html))

```
:::
